title: Circumpolar Arctic Land Cover for circa 2020 (CALC-2020)
abstract: Circumpolar Arctic Land Cover for circa 2020 (CALC-2020) is a new baseline land cover product that maps the entire terrestrial Arctic (tree line nowthward) at 10m resolution. This dataset is derived from Sentinel-1/2 and ArcticDEM, using locally adaptive machine learning models trained by sample over 58,000 site locations.
citation: Xiaoqing Xu, Chong Liu, Caixia Liu, et al. (2022) . Circumpolar Arctic Land Cover for circa 2020 (CALC-2020). V1. Science Data Bank. https://doi.org/10.57760/sciencedb.01869.
